title: The Lilac-Breasted Roller and Other Colourful Birds
excerpt: The lilac-breasted roller is one of the most colourful birds on safari. Plus other striking birds to look out for.
body:
## The roller

With lilac, turquoise and blue feathers, the lilac-breasted roller is a favourite among photographers. It often sits on dead branches.

## Other colourful birds

- **Superb starling:** shiny blue-green with orange.
- **Bee-eaters:** carmine, little and white-fronted bee-eaters.
- **Grey crowned crane:** with its golden crown.
- **Fischer's lovebird:** small and colourful, found in north-central Tanzania.
- **Kingfishers:** malachite and pied kingfishers.

## Tip

Use binoculars and ask your guide for names.

See [birdwatching for beginners](/blog/birdwatching-tanzania/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
